{{Top|leg}}
The '''Police Academy''' was a [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] academy on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Deysum III]]. [[Mendegar|Nell Wenn]], a resident of Deysum III who admired law enforcement, entered the Academy at sixteen. However, after joining the ranks of the [[Constable/Legends|constables]], she found many of her fellow law enforcers to be corrupt.<ref name="J15">{{JournalCite|15|Tasariq: The Crystal Planet}}</ref>
